name: co2-ppm
title: Atmospheric CO2 at Mauna Loa, Monthly Mean (1958–2026)
description: Monthly mean atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO2) dry-air mole fraction at Mauna Loa Observatory, Hawaii, in parts per million (ppm), from March 1958 to July 2026, as published by the NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory (GML). Data from March 1958 through April 1974 were measured by C. David Keeling of the Scripps Institution of Oceanography (SIO); NOAA measurements start in May 1974. Monthly values are built from daily means and corrected to the centre of the month using the average seasonal cycle. Missing months have been interpolated by the source. Because of the Mauna Loa volcano eruption, measurements were suspended from 29 November 2022 and resumed in July 2023: observations from December 2022 to 4 July 2023 are from a site at the Maunakea Observatories, about 21 miles north of Mauna Loa. Snapshot of the source file retrieved 2026-08-30 (file created by NOAA on 2026-08-05).

resources.name: co2-mm-mlo
resources.title: Monthly mean CO2 at Mauna Loa
resources.description: One row per month, March 1958 to July 2026, with no gaps. Values are copied from the NOAA GML file; the source's negative 'not available' codes are written as empty cells.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Calendar month of the observation (YYYY-MM). Source columns `year` and `month`.

fields.name: decimal_year
fields.description: Mid-month as a decimal year, as given by the source (`decimal date`).

fields.name: co2_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO2 dry-air mole fraction, parts per million (source `average`). Includes months interpolated by the source.

fields.name: co2_deseasonalized_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO2 with the average seasonal cycle removed, parts per million (source `deseasonalized`).

fields.name: days_measured
fields.description: Number of days with data in the month (source `ndays`). Empty where the source gives -1: all SIO months (March 1958 – April 1974), for which no count is available, and NOAA months it interpolated.

fields.name: daily_sdev_ppm
fields.description: Standard deviation of the daily means within the month, parts per million (source `sdev`). Empty where the source gives -9.99 (not available: SIO months and interpolated or sparse NOAA months).

fields.name: uncertainty_ppm
fields.description: Uncertainty of the monthly mean, parts per million (source `unc`). Empty where the source gives -0.99 (not available), and for 1975-12 and 1984-04, where the source gives 0.00 next to a missing sdev.
